mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 3 months, exceeding 0.5 percentage points, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it signals a synchronized strengthening of residential investment and consumer spending that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both > 12-mo MA but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing faster than its 6-month moving average, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 6-mo MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and industrial production is accelerating, it signals a strengthening supply-side recovery that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and accelerating but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising faster than 2% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an inflationary environment that will erode the purchasing power of fixed-income assets and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 55% of the time.
